headline: Quiet day: DeepSeek's Harness agent app hits 1.54 million users
body: A quiet Sunday with one event. DeepSeek's Harness agent app reached 1.54 million daily users, lifting AI Autonomy by 0.13. Benevolent Dictator edged up and Enslaved God slipped. Horizon Balance was almost unchanged at -10.19, from -10.23.
movers_note: Enslaved God -0.1, from fading earlier news (-0.08) and the Harness milestone (-0.05). Benevolent Dictator +0.08, from the Harness milestone (+0.10), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.02). Reversion +0.05, from fading earlier news (+0.05).
